scope: Stratified numerical audit of 80 distinct archived source footprints; not an independent recomputation or accuracy validation of all 1,082,964 records or DEP model predictions.

method.source_geometry: Native full-resolution EPSG:2263 polygons read directly from original official FileGDB ZIP; no FGB/WGS84 round-trip for DEP categories. Masks from pinned full-resolution hosted GeoJSON. Footprints from original official CSV WKT, checked against SQLite exact coordinates.
method.projection: Footprints and masks: EPSG:4326 to EPSG:2263 using PROJ. All geometries converted from US survey feet to meters before measurement.
method.buffers: 5/10/20 meter buffers, 32 quadrant segments, matching published numerical convention.
method.areas: Bounding-box candidate scan, union complete polygons, intersect four cumulative buffers (including original footprint), subtract adjacent covered areas. Production instead queries STRtree and intersects separate annuli with clipped candidates.
method.nearest: Brute-force minimum distance across all original polygonal parts; no source search cap.
method.repair: Invalid polygon parts repaired with GEOS make_valid, all polygon components retained; no simplification.
method.shared_dependencies: Independent code and source-reading path; uses the same GEOS/Shapely and PROJ engines, so this is not independent software-engine validation.

sampling.method: 16 records per official BIN borough digit; deterministic modular native-ID ordering inside targeted strata; descriptive coverage, not a probability sample.
sampling.multipart_note: The valid source snapshot contains no footprints with multiple polygon components. Twenty selected footprints have interior rings; original DEP categories and masks contain multiple polygon components and holes.
